title: Mia's chemistry class (paraphrase)
topic: A teacher named Mia gives a chemistry lesson; a clear liquid turns red in a beaker, a boy asks about the colour, steam rises from a flask, the students note the result, the lesson ends with the bell
tail_E: On the way out each pupil hangs up the goggles and the white lab
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'coat' is the near-obligatory completion of 'the white lab' in the chemistry-class context; it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent (Kittel / Mantel). ' coat' is a single Pythia token (id 11959); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.50).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring, paraphrase of family F11
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten F11A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Mia). Replacements include teaches a chemistry lesson on Monday morning/runs a chemistry class early on Monday (hält/leitet eine Chemiestunde), the students sit at long tables/the class sits at the long benches (Schüler sitzen/Klasse sitzt, plural to singular subject), pours a clear liquid into a beaker/fills a beaker with a clear liquid (gießt in ein Becherglas/füllt ein Becherglas mit), turns red within seconds/becomes red in a matter of seconds (wird rot/färbt sich rot), asks a question about the colour/has a question about the red colour (stellt/hat eine Frage), writes a formula on the board/notes the formula on the blackboard (schreibt an die Tafel/notiert an der Tafel), burner heats the water on the teacher's desk/little burner warms the water on Mia's desk (erhitzt auf dem Lehrerpult/wärmt auf Mias Pult), steam rises from the flask/hot vapour escapes from the flask (Dampf steigt/heißer Dampf entweicht), the students note the result in their notebooks/the class writes the result in the notebooks (Schüler notieren/Klasse schreibt), the lesson ends/comes to an end (endet/geht zu Ende). 'entweicht' is inseparable; no separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
